primary: B_plus minus B, historical_holdout,10sessions,10bps roundtrip, equal-weight common ETFs

bootstrap.method: nonoverlapping20trading-date-block cluster resampling; all ETFs/rules resampled together
bootstrap.valid_draw: all fixed common ETFs have B and B_plus events in resampled blocks

criterion: do not claim confirmed optimization without genuinely unseen forward validation. Historical evidence is supportive only if primary mean delta>0, lower CI>0, and >half common ETFs positive; report all missing/contradictory outcomes. Fewer than8 eligible ETFs => incomplete planned panel.
baseline: unconditional same-ETF same-segment next-open to hth-close gross return; net excess subtracts this gross drift reference, explicitly not a portfolio
paired_filter_diagnostic: also partition already-retained B cohort by same-day adjusted price up; report retained/excluded counts and outcomes, never rename negative-day crosses invalid without return evidence
secondary: all prespecified horizons/costs/rules shown, no best variant selected
event_summary: no annualization, portfolio allocation, idle-cash or overlapping-signal compounding; MAE is gross adverse excursion from entry equity
signal_adjustment_limit: causal cumulative share/cash-unit adjusted closes; not verified identical to App qfq at every corporate action
